title: Rav Gada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Sheshet’s attendant, as in Eruvin 11b, which relates that once the Exilarch’s servants imprisoned him. Rav Sheshet (who was blind) stood at the gate and called, “Gada, come out,” and they released him and he came out. In Shabbat 145b: “Rav Yosef said — and Rav Gada also said (so is Dikdukei Soferim’s reading; the Gemara has Rav Gaza): Once I visited there and made Babylonian kutach, and all the sick of the West asked me for it.”

notes.text: Saved Rashi on Shabbat 145b explicitly glosses בריחי as sick people, supporting that rendering. Saved Davidson has Gaza in the kutach passage; Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim Gada reading remains separate.
